title: The Missing Cipher
author: Mirabel Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Marchetti, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
